clue.text: Headless ghosts from hell

parts.note: shades are ghosts or spirits of the dead

clue.text: Exhilaration brought by organised games after a short time

explanation.walkthrough: Perch looks like the fish but is the old unit of length, a rod or pole.
explanation.definitionFit: The dory, or John Dory, is a sea fish, so it is another fish besides the perch.

clue.text: Lacking emotion and energy in attempt to convey phony praise

parts.note: a try is an attempt

explanation.definitionFit: Flattery is insincere, excessive praise.

clue.text: Reject is coming in unhappy

parts.note: down means unhappy or depressed

clue.text: Old boy with hunger evident in figure

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

clue.text: Reputation coming from facts and figures about university

clue.text: Drag Queen's rise

clue.text: Base liar, ridiculous teller of stories

clue.text: Part of digestive system upset by muesli ——- avoid seconds!

clue.text: What comes with start of Christmas strange repartee

indicators.note: strange means odd, so the letters are rearranged
